北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天微凉，湿度较低，记得多喝水润润喉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and cool with low humidity. Remember to drink more water!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，气温适中。注意保暖，出门记得带伞哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with moderate temperatures. Stay warm and bring an umbrella!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微凉，体感舒适。外出记得增添衣物，以防着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool, feeling comfortable. Dress in layers when going out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天有点闷热，湿度较大。注意防潮，保持身体清爽！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, warm and humid. Stay cool and pay attention to moisture!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感温暖偏湿。轻装出行，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy, warm and humid. Dress lightly and keep a good mood!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，能见度不高。驾车出行请减速慢行，注意安全。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy with low visibility. Drive carefully and slowly for safety.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，阳光正好，气温宜人。享受美好的一天吧！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and pleasant. Enjoy this beautiful day!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温适宜。出门记得带把伞，有备无患哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Carry an umbrella just in case.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感微凉。风力稍大，出门别忘添衣哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels a bit cool. With light breeze, remember to wear more layers!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感偏冷且非常干燥。请注意补水保湿，多喝温水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels cold and very dry. Please hydrate well and drink warm water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温舒适。记得多喝水，保持好心情哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Remember to hydrate and stay cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感寒冷，风力较大。务必穿厚保暖，戴好帽子手套！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels very cold with strong winds. Be sure to dress warmly with hat and gloves!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有大雾，能见度差，气温较低。注意交通安全，出行保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is very foggy with low visibility and cold. Drive safely and stay warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感微凉。出门注意添衣，别忘了防晒哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy and feels a bit cool. Dress in layers and don't forget sun protection.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，阳光和煦，湿度较大。享受海风，保持好心情！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and pleasant, with high humidity. Enjoy the sea breeze and stay cheerful!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，能见度不高，气温较低。注意防潮保暖，出行安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with low visibility and cool temperatures. Stay warm and travel safely.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，气温较低。行车小心，别忘了添衣保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy and cold. Drive carefully and remember to dress warmly!
